# Display Table with Border

#### Course: Learn HTML

## Display Table with Border

You need to use CSS to create borders around table rows and cells.

We will learn about CSS in another course. For now, let's use CSS to see how our table looks with borders added.

```html
1<!-- HTML code to create the table -->
2<table>
3  <tr>
4    <td>Harry</td>
5    <td>18</td>
6    <td>England</td>
7  </tr>
8
9  <tr>
10    <td>John</td>
11    <td>18</td>
12    <td>USA</td>
13  </tr>
14</table>
15
16<!-- CSS to add borders -->
17<style>
18    table, th, td {
19        border: 1px solid black;
20    }
21</style>
```

Now, if you run the code, you can clearly see the table rows and data cells.

![A webpage showing a table with borders.](data:image/png;base64,)

![Idea Emoji](data:image/png;base64,)

From now on, we will use this CSS code to better visualize HTML tables.
